data.name: Taliviah
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Taliviah means "God is my Rock". This powerful name is rooted in the Old Testament, where God is often referred to as a solid foundation or refuge. The name is a reminder of the unwavering strength and stability that comes from trusting in God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Taliviah carries a rich cultural significance as it is derived from the ancient Hebrew language. It represents the deep connection between the Jewish people and their faith in God. This name has been passed down through generations and holds a special place in Jewish and Christian heritage. It serves as a reminder of the enduring faith and strength of the people who carry this name.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Taliviah conveys the idea that God is our rock, our foundation, and our refuge in times of need. This name encourages those who bear it to trust in God's unfailing love and strength. It reminds us that no matter what challenges we may face, God is always present and reliable. In times of uncertainty, Taliviah is a reminder to seek solace in the steadfast love of God.
